findings.reason: Reviewed the complete article and dossier against the supplied scan of printed page 49 (PDF page 61). The finding concerns unresolved glyph specimens g023–g026 above the 菜 entry. The article makes no claim that depends on identifying those specimens: its graphic analysis, component split, definition, and cited usages are supported by the printed 菜 entry text and other cited evidence. The dossier explicitly preserves the specimen identity gap and does not assign those occurrences a Unicode identity. Thus no article or dossier claim depends on or uses the unresolved identity.
